product_metadata.title: Dirt Devil Versa Clean Bagless Stick Vacuum Cleaner and Hand Vac, 16feet Power Cord, SD20010, Red
features: LIGHTWEIGHT STICK VACUUM CLEANER: Lets you move from room to room and up and down stairs with ease
MULTI SURFACE CAPABILITY: Works on both rugs, carpet, and hard floors
CONVERTS TO A HAND VAC: Tackle those curtains, shelvers, counters and upholstered furniture
description: Designed for the way you live! This innovative stick vac is perfect for rugs and hard floors and it converts easily to a hand vac. Just detach the nozzle & handle tube from the hand vac and you are ready for dust, dirt and crumbs on furniture, counters, shelves, upholstery and drapes. An on-board crevice tool allows you to reach around furniture, in tight spaces in corners and along the edges. The lightweight design lets you move the vacuum from room to room and up and down stairs. It's smart, bag less design is easy to empty.

details.Specific instructions for use: Floor, Rug, Upholstery, Stair and Shelves
